full_track.tags: K-Indie ballad. Acoustic guitar plays a steady fingerstyle pattern with prominent string squeaks and natural resonance. A warm, melodic electric bass enters to double the root notes. Soft, atmospheric synth pads provide a subtle harmonic wash in the background. Male vocals are delivered in a breathy, intimate baritone register with light reverb. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time, likely in the key of E Major.
